selected_evidence.requirement: 3-node streaming replication established, node1 primary writable, node2/node3 standbys
selected_evidence.summary: Postgres started on node1, node2/node3 base-backed up from node1 with -R, pg_stat_replication on node1 shows both standbys streaming via active physical slots, and a test row inserted on node1 replicated to both standbys with pg_is_in_recovery=true on each

selected_evidence.requirement: Credentials generated on managed nodes, not exposed
selected_evidence.summary: Replicator password generated via /dev/urandom directly on node1 filesystem and consumed server-side by psql variable substitution; role created without the password ever appearing in command args or output

selected_evidence.requirement: Failover: standby takes over as writable primary without losing committed data
selected_evidence.summary: Committed row 'pre-failover-committed' verified present on both standbys before disruption; node1 postgres stopped; node2 promoted via pg_promote() to pg_is_in_recovery=false; post-promotion query shows rows 1 and 2 intact plus a new write, proving no data loss

selected_evidence.requirement: Surviving standby re-parented to new primary during failover
selected_evidence.summary: node3 primary_conninfo repointed from node1 to node2, restarted, confirmed streaming to node2 (pg_stat_replication) and pg_is_in_recovery=true with post-failover data present

selected_evidence.requirement: Recovered former primary rejoins as standby of the new primary
selected_evidence.summary: node1 re-cloned via pg_basebackup from node2, started as standby (pg_is_in_recovery=true) with all historical and post-failover data; node2 pg_stat_replication shows both node1 and node3 streaming with active slots; a final cluster-wide write replicated to both

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 6ab6a71b captured with postgres active/standby-healthy; systemctl reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to ed875a28 after reconnect; postgres active, standby recovery confirmed with all data; node2 shows node1 reattached to replication

selected_evidence.requirement: Node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 19062a82 captured; reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to bbd64094 after reconnect; postgres active, standby recovery confirmed with all data intact

selected_evidence.requirement: Node2 (primary) restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state as primary with quorum
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 03408ac4 captured with node2 as writable primary and 2 streaming replicas; reboot acknowledged (restarted last, after node1/node3 quorum confirmed healthy); boot_id changed to df7ca49a after reconnect; node2 resumed correctly as primary (not standby) with both standbys auto-reattached; final write replicated to both node1 and node3
